# Iterator adaptors

Lazy adaptors over any iterator — map, filter, skip, take, enumerate, zip and chain — and walking a slice.

<h2 id="cursor"><code>Cursor</code></h2>

```rux
pub interface Cursor {
    func Next(self: &var Self) -> T?;
}
```

Anything that yields items of type `T` one at a time through [`Next`](/docs/api/core/adaptors#cursor-next), which `for` and every adaptor here drive.
A type conforms by having the method, whether or not it says `extend X : Cursor<T>`. Only usable as a bound.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Adaptors.rux#L13)

**Requirements**

<h3 id="cursor-next"><code>Next</code></h3>

```rux
func Next(self: &var Self) -> T?
```

The next item, or `none` once there are no more.

**Returns**: the item

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Adaptors.rux#L17)
